WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT * FROM lfl_sales ORDER BY fiscal_year

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, s.store_id, SUM(x.v) AS mine
  FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, f.store_key, f.net_amount AS v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, r.store_key, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  ) x JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=x.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=x.dt
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2
), ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=c.business_date
  WHERE c.store_id < 900 AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, ROUND(m.mine,2) mine, ROUND(c.ctl,2) ctl, ROUND(m.mine-c.ctl,2) gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON m.fiscal_year=c.fiscal_year AND m.store_id=c.store_id
WHERE m.mine IS NULL OR c.ctl IS NULL OR ABS(m.mine-c.ctl) > 0.5
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id || '-' || f.line_no) AS distinct_receipt_lines, MIN(f.sale_date) mn, MAX(f.sale_date) mx, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_lines
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.store_id, c.store_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END),0) ty, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END),0) ly,
 ROUND(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END),0)-1),1) pct,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN business_date END) days_ty, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN business_date END) days_ly
FROM (SELECT r.business_date, r.store_id, r.net_sales AS net, d.fiscal_year FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900) x
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id, store_name FROM dim_store WHERE is_current) c ON c.store_id=x.store_id
GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING ABS(COALESCE(100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN net END)/NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN net END),0)-1),999))>8 OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN business_date END)<>28 OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN business_date END)<>28
ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 14 AS first_week, 17 AS last_week),
range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week),
weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 4 AS fiscal_period, ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
